extraction.name: OWSM v4: Improving Open Whisper-Style Speech Models via Data Scaling and Cleaning
extraction.description: Paper describing a scalable data-cleaning pipeline for the YODAS speech dataset and training of OWSM v4 speech models using cleaned YODAS plus existing OWSM data.
extraction.creator: Yifan Peng, Muhammad Shakeel, Yui Sudo, William Chen, Jinchuan Tian, Chyi-Jiunn Lin, Shinji Watanabe
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The paper uses the YODAS dataset, described as a large-scale web-crawled dataset. The authors apply a data-cleaning pipeline that realigns audio and text using CTC segmentation, filters by language identification on audio and text, and filters by CTC confidence scores. The cleaned subset is then used for training OWSM v4 models.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: The raw YODAS data may contain incorrect language labels and audio-text misalignments; some timestamps are inaccurate. Utterances consisting exclusively of non-speech elements, such as music, are removed.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: YODAS, a web-crawled dataset of audio and speech with unsegmented long-form recordings and text transcriptions annotated with start and end timestamps.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Audio and text are realigned using the CTC segmentation algorithm with a publicly available OWSM-CTC v3.2 model; long-form recordings are segmented into shorter utterances with a maximum duration of 30 seconds; utterances with only non-speech elements are removed; utterances are filtered by matching original language labels against predicted labels from text-based and spoken LID models; low-quality utterances are removed using language-dependent CTC confidence score thresholds.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Resegmentation into shorter utterances, removal of non-speech-only utterances, LID-based filtering to keep only utterances whose original label matches both text and audio predictions, and CTC-score-based filtering using a threshold of theta_CTC = 0.10 to retain higher-quality aligned utterances.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: YODAS includes text transcriptions annotated with start and end timestamps and language labels. The paper does not describe a new human annotation process; instead, it cleans existing annotations and uses model-based filtering and realignment.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The paper uses model predictions to assess annotation quality: text-based LID from fastText, spoken LID from ECAPA-TDNN via SpeechBrain, and CTC confidence scores from segmentation. The authors note that raw YODAS contains noisy annotations and that filtering improves performance.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: CTC segmentation algorithm, OWSM-CTC v3.2, fastText language identification model, ECAPA-TDNN spoken language identification model from SpeechBrain, ESPnet, PyTorch, FlashAttention-2
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The authors state that they will publicly release the cleaned YODAS data, data-cleaning scripts, training code, pre-trained model weights, and training logs via the ESPnet toolkit. No versioning or deprecation policy is specified.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The paper emphasizes open research, transparency, and reproducibility in speech foundation models, and notes concerns about privacy, transparency, and reproducibility in non-public training data. It aims to advance open academic research by releasing cleaned data and scripts.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The cleaned YODAS data remains highly imbalanced across languages, with English constituting the largest share and many other languages underrepresented.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The raw YODAS data contains incorrect language labels and audio-text misalignments. The cleaned dataset still has an imbalanced language distribution, and the authors keep the original distribution without resampling. The paper also notes that some evaluation sets may have higher error rates due to transcription issues.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and fine-tuning speech foundation models for multilingual ASR, LID, and speech translation; the cleaned YODAS data is used alongside previous OWSM data to train OWSM v4 models.
